newsitem.title: USA: Armco says specialty steel prices weak.
newsitem.headline: Armco says specialty steel prices weak.

text.p: Armco Inc said Thursday that despite recently announced price increases, average selling prices for specialty steels are weaker than at this time a year ago.
In a press release, the company said that specialty steel imports are flooding the market at or near the record high levels of 1996 and continue to have a detrimental effect on pricing.

Armco said that demand is relatively stable for most of its product lines, but that it expects volume to decline during the third quarter as a result of seasonal model changeovers by automotive customers and other customer summer maintenance outages.
